subject: Align server.lastsave and server.rdb_save_time_last by removing multiple calls to time(NULL) (#12823)
reason: The change is a timekeeping consistency refactor in backgroundSaveDoneHandler: one time(NULL) sample at handler entry now sets both server.lastsave and server.rdb_save_time_last, instead of two separate calls. No control flow, persistence format, replication behavior, or reply shape changes. The only observable effect is removing a possible <=1-second skew between LASTSAVE and INFO's rdb_last_bgsave_time_sec when the clock ticks between the two old calls — a race that cannot be reproduced deterministically.
